scripts.icon: tauri icon assets/icon.png -o src-tauri/icons && tauri icon assets/icon-windows.png -o src-tauri/icons/.windows && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/icons/.windows/icon.ico','src-tauri/icons/icon.ico');fs.rmSync('src-tauri/icons/.windows',{recursive:true})"
scripts.notices: cargo about generate --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -c src-tauri/about.toml -o THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md src-tauri/about.hbs
